stem.platetectonics.bd_haza_deep_earthqu: Deep earthquakes (Wadati-Benioff zone); explosive volcanism; deep trenches
stem.platetectonics.bd_feat_coastal_moun: Coastal mountain ranges + volcanic arcs + trenches
stem.platetectonics.bd_haza_mountain_bui: Mountain building, andesite volcanoes, megathrust earthquakes

stem.platetectonics.bd_haza_shallow_stri: Shallow strike-slip earthquakes; no volcanism; lateral displacement
